Grip is building the infrastructure for enterprise content production-turning static master creatives into scalable, high-quality outputs through automation, AI workflows, and modular design systems. This role sits at the intersection of creative intent and production reliability.
As a Video Editor , you’ll create final edits and market adaptations, making sure every version keeps the quality, creative direction, and brand standards of the approved master. You’ll work with large volumes of content and prepare assets for automated delivery.
What You Will Do

• Replace VFX shots in final edits, checking timing, alignment, and consistency.

• Create cutdowns and adaptations that preserve the story and visual style.

• Resize and reframe videos for formats such as 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5.

• Check every delivery for video, audio, colour, and VFX issues, including single-frame errors.

• Fix or flag colour mismatches, compression issues, audio imbalance, and render errors.

• Export assets to the correct broadcast, social, and web specifications.

• Receive, check, and organise master files from vendors.

• Transcode files using the correct codecs, formats, and colour spaces, and create MP4 review files.

• Follow and improve editing and quality control workflows, finding solutions that can be applied across many versions.

• Prepare assets for automated pipelines and distribution.

• Work with project managers and VFX supervisors, apply creative feedback, and flag issues early.

• Act as the final quality check before assets enter production systems, ensuring deliveries are ready to use and on schedule.

Requirements
Who You Are
You’re a detail-focused editor who cares about visual quality and understands how to keep it consistent across many versions.
What You Bring

• Proven video editing experience with a strong portfolio across formats and platforms.

• Hands-on experience with Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.

• An understanding of VFX workflows and post-production pipelines.

• Good knowledge of codecs, formats, transcoding, compression, and delivery specifications.

• Experience checking video, audio, and colour quality.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to spot subtle inconsistencies.

• An organised approach to managing files, versions, and large volumes of content.

• The ability to learn new tools, solve problems, and work closely with creative and technical teams.

• Reliability under production deadlines.

• A fast, reliable internet connection, a powerful computer that can handle 4K footage, and enough storage for large project files.

Why Join Grip?
The Platform Position.
Grip is infrastructure for enterprise creative production-powering content generation across global brands with strict quality requirements.
The Market Timing.
AI is increasing content volume exponentially. The bottleneck is no longer creation-it’s maintaining quality at scale.
The Technical Moat.
A multi-tenant platform combining AI workflow orchestration, ComfyUI integrations, and production-grade pipelines across TypeScript, Python, Elixir, and C#.
The Work.
You define what “quality” means in a system generating thousands of assets-and ensure it holds under scale.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Job Description:
Business Development Representative
Club OS One
THE COMPANY
ClubOS One is a fast-growing, all-in-one gym management software platform designed to streamline operations, increase member engagement, and drive revenue growth for fitness clubs of all sizes. We combine CRM, member sign-ups, billing, scheduling, and payment processing into one powerful, user-friendly solution. As we expand our footprint in the fitness tech space, we're looking for passionate professionals ready to help gyms thrive.
POSITION
The Business Development Representative (BDR) supports the Sales organization by identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective sales opportunities before transitioning qualified opportunities to the appropriate Sales Representative.
The BDR serves as an important first point of contact for prospective clients and plays a key role in building a healthy sales pipeline. This position is responsible for understanding a prospect's business needs, determining their level of interest and sales readiness, gathering relevant information, and ensuring the Sales team receives well-qualified opportunities with the information needed to move efficiently through the sales process.
In addition to new business opportunities, the BDR supports Back to Base initiatives by identifying and qualifying opportunities within the existing client base for additional products and services.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Respond to and engage assigned leads through telephone, email, and other approved communication channels.

• Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand the prospect's business, needs, challenges, current solutions, decision-making process, and level of interest.

• Qualify prospective opportunities using established criteria to determine fit and sales readiness.

• Schedule qualified prospects with the appropriate Sales Representative and provide a clear, complete handoff of information gathered during the qualification process.

• Maintain consistent and timely follow-up with leads that require additional nurturing before they are ready to engage with Sales.

• Conduct outbound prospecting activities as assigned to identify and develop new potential business opportunities.

• Support Back to Base sales initiatives by reviewing existing client accounts and identifying opportunities for additional products, services, or solutions.

• Contact existing clients as part of Back to Base campaigns to determine interest, business need, and readiness for additional solutions before transitioning qualified opportunities to Sales.

• Develop a working knowledge of company products, services, pricing structure, target markets, and ideal customer profiles to effectively identify potential opportunities.

• Accurately document prospect and client interactions, qualification information, follow-up activities, and outcomes within HubSpot and other designated systems.

• Maintain accurate lead statuses and ensure opportunities are appropriately progressed, nurtured, disqualified, or transitioned based on established processes.

• Partner closely with assigned Sales Representatives to understand priorities, target opportunities, qualification expectations, and feedback regarding lead quality.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Customer Success, and other internal teams when opportunities or relevant client information are identified.

• Meet established performance expectations related to outreach activity, response time, qualified opportunities, scheduled meetings, lead conversion, and Back to Base initiatives.

• Participate in sales training, coaching, team meetings, and ongoing product education to continuously improve sales development skills and product knowledge.

• Provide feedback regarding common prospect questions, objections, competitive information, and market trends identified through conversations.

• Represent the company professionally and create a positive experience during every prospect and client interaction.

OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX Brazil is building its finance function from the ground up while preparing for supervision by the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) under the new virtual asset service provider (SPSAV/PSAV) framework. We are looking for a Finance & Accounting Analyst to join our Brazil team and take ownership of core day-to-day accounting, accounts payable, and tax-compliance operations.

You will work alongside the Senior Finance Manager and the Finance & Accounting Specialist, in a role where accuracy, documentation, and discipline matter. Our books will soon be reviewed by a regulator, not only by auditors. This is a strong opportunity for someone early in their career who wants hands-on exposure to financial regulation, crypto, and Brazil’s tax reform.

What You’ll Be Doing

•
Accounting & Month-End Close

•
Prepare monthly close activities, including journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, prepayments, and recurring accounting schedules.

•
Prepare and review intercompany journal entries and reconcile intercompany balances with affiliates to ensure accuracy and consistency.

•
Maintain close checklists and supporting documentation in FloQast and NetSuite, meeting group reporting deadlines.

•
Support the local Portuguese-language books, helping keep entries aligned with Brazilian GAAP and the BCB chart of accounts (COSIF) as we prepare for regulated status.

•
Accounts Payable & Expense Management

•
Process vendor invoices, employee reimbursements, and weekly payment batches in line with internal policies and approval matrices.

•
Validate vendor documentation and apply the correct tax treatment before payment.

•
Review withholding taxes on vendor payments (IRRF, PIS/COFINS/CSLL, INSS, ISS), and keep payment files and supporting documents audit-ready.

•
Tax Compliance Support

•
Issue electronic invoices for company operations, ensuring accuracy and compliance with municipal and federal requirements.

•
Support the monthly review of VAT and CIT calculations and maintain supporting documentation.

•
Support tax-to-accounting reconciliations and coordinate with our outsourced accounting firm on filings and information requests.

•
Help us follow and prepare for the Brazilian tax reform (IBS/CBS) transition, including the impact on invoicing, vendor payments, and ERP configuration.

•
Audit & Controls

•
Support external audit and group-level audit requests: prepare PBC lists, schedules, and reconciliations.

•
Follow documented controls and flag exceptions or gaps. Contribute to SOPs and process improvements as we build a controlled environment suited to a regulated entity.

What We’re Looking For

•
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (CRC registration is a plus).

•
3+ years of experience in accounting, preferably in financial services, fintech, crypto, or big 4.

•
Solid knowledge of IFRS and BR GAAP/CPC. Familiarity with tax is a plus.

•
Hands-on experience with month-end closing, reconciliations, and AP processes.

•
Strong attention to detail, a sense of ownership, and the discipline to document your work.

•
Intermediate-to-advance

title: Une Ingénieure ou un Ingénieur : procédés et formation en salle blanche microélectronique - Centre Microélectronique de Provence – CDD 2 ans
description:
L’Institut Mines-Télécom est le premier groupe public français de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management. Il fédère huit écoles publiques, deux écoles filiales et un vaste réseau de partenaires académiques, industriels et institutionnels.
Mines Saint-Étienne, école de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, assure des missions de formation, de recherche, d’innovation et de transfert industriel. Avec 2 500 élèves, 500 personnels et un budget de 50 M€, elle dispose de trois campus spécialisés. Sa stratégie 2023-2027 vise à accompagner les transitions écologique, numérique et générationnelle, tout en contribuant à la souveraineté nationale et européenne en microélectronique et numérique.
Le campus Aix-Marseille-Provence, situé à Gardanne, regroupe le Centre Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), des formations d’ingénieurs et de masters, un incubateur technologique et des plateformes de prototypage. Il accueille environ 400 étudiants et 200 personnels de Mines Saint-Étienne et d’entreprises partenaires.
Le CMP dispose d’une salle blanche de 700 m², équipée d’une centaine d’équipements scientifiques répartis en zones de classes 100, 1 000 et 10 000. Cette plateforme est utilisée par les équipes de recherche, les membres académiques et industriels de l’association Micro-PackS, ainsi que pour les formations initiales et continues.
Ses activités couvrent notamment les procédés de couches minces, la photolithographie, la chimie, la caractérisation physique et électrique des matériaux et dispositifs, le micropackaging, l’électronique imprimée et la préparation d’échantillons.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous
Dans le cadre du projet I-novmicro porté par le Campus des Métiers et des Qualifications Industrie du Futur, des modules de formation aux procédés de fabrication en microélectronique sont proposés à des étudiants et apprenants en formation initiale ou continue. La formation se concentrera sur la réalisation de transistor NMOS.
Le Centre de Microélectronique de Provence recrute un ingénieur pour mettre en place et dispenser ces formations, gérer les opérations nécessaires au bon déroulement de celles-ci.

Vos Missions :
Achat d’équipements
La personne retenue gérera, dans un premier temps, l’achat de nouveaux équipements destinés aux formations décrites en introduction.
Mise en place de la formation
La personne sera chargée de développer le module de formation sur le transistor NMOS, en ciblant certains procédés de fabrication. Elle assurera ensuite l’animation des sessions de formation aux procédés microélectroniques associées à ce module.
Ainsi, la personne recrutée devra être former aux procédés standard utilisés en microélectronique (front-end), et effectuer les étapes de fabrication de composants, développées dans le cadre des formations dispensées. Elle sera également en charge du développement de nouveaux procédés. Dans le cadre de ces missions, la ou le titulaire du poste devra utiliser des produits chimiques, et donc en gérer les aspects sécurité. Elle devra utiliser des équipements de caractérisation (ex : microscopie, ellipsométrie, profilométrie) dans le cadre des formations dispensées, et devra pouvoir former des utilisateurs à ces techniques.
Recherche
Etant associé aux départements de recherche du CMP, notamment le département d’électronique flexible, des activités complémentaires de recherche sont envisageables.

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons
Les candidates et candidats doivent être titulaires au minimum d’un bac+5, et avoir une expérience dans la microélectronique, en process et caractérisation en salle blanche.
Une forte polyvalence est requise pour ce poste, avec notamment des compétences en :

• Procédés (connaissance et maîtrise) : photolithographie, gravure humide et sèche, dépôts de couches minces et traitements thermiques,

• Caractérisation physique de matériaux et dispositifs, et caractérisation électrique de dispositifs.

Une expérience dans le domaine de la formation technique est un réel atout.

description:
About Pave Bank:
Pave Bank is the world’s first programmable business bank. Built by the founders behind Monzo and BigPay, we are redefining global business banking by integrating programmable financial infrastructure with world-class client experiences.
About the Role:
As a Senior Trader at Pave Bank, you'll play a key role in executing multi-asset trading strategies and managing the bank's FX and digital asset exposures, liquidity, and treasury operations across global markets. Working across G20 and emerging-market FX, fixed income, derivatives, and digital assets/stablecoins, you'll help optimise trade execution, manage risk, and strengthen the bank's network of liquidity providers and OTC counterparties.
Beyond day-to-day trading, you'll have the opportunity to build and improve trading and treasury workflows, leveraging AI tools and automation to enhance efficiency, market analysis, and decision-making. High-Impact Execution

• Build and manage the firm's OTC book, actively sourcing the next high-value trading opportunities for the desk.

• Devise and implement execution strategies for the desk to maximise risk-adjusted returns.

Treasury & Risk Management

• Manage real-time FX and digital asset exposures within defined limits, running smart hedging and inventory positioning across 30+ currencies.

• Own intraday and end-of-day treasury operations across banks, OTC desks, exchanges, and digital wallets - maximising capital efficiency and driving idle funds to capture yield.

Partner & Counterparty Strategy

• Help manage and expand our network of liquidity providers and OTC counterparties.

• Onboard partners, benchmark pricing performance, and eliminate single points of failure across active trading corridors.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

AI, Tooling & Process Innovation

• Champion the use of AI tools and automation to streamline daily desk reporting, market analysis, and treasury forecasts, cutting out manual friction wherever it lives.

• Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in FX, OTC execution, treasury, or liquidity management at a buy-side/sell-side institution, bank, broker, crypto firm, or fintech.

• Multi-Asset Knowledge: A solid grasp of global financial markets, including FX (G20 & EM), fixed income products, derivatives, and digital assets. Hands-on experience trading digital assets is a major plus.

• AI Mindset: Active familiarity with AI tools and automation methods to optimise personal workflows, solve complex operational challenges, and scale desk capacity.

• Technical & Quantitative Skills: Highly numerate with advanced Excel capabilities. Experience with SQL, Python, or building custom trading/treasury tools is a major bonus.

title: Chief of Staff
description:

- Cross-functional Leadership: Du agierst als Bindeglied zwischen den Commercial-Teams und Product/Tech, brichst Silos auf und sorgst dafür, dass alle an einem Strang ziehen, um unsere OKRs zu übertreffen.

Dein Profil: Wir suchen einen analytischen Vordenker mit einer absoluten "Get-shit-done"-Mentalität. Du kannst auf Flughöhe strategisch diskutieren, scheust dich aber nicht davor, tief in die Daten oder operativen Prozesse abzutauchen.

Kommunikationsstärke: Du kommunizierst präzise, auf den Punkt und kannst auf C-Level sowie im Board-Kontext souverän agieren.
Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (Muttersprachenniveau) und exzellente Englischkenntnisse.

Warum Cosuno?

Flexibilität & Kultur: Arbeite aus unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain oder nutze unser hybrides Modell. Wir pflegen eine Kultur der absoluten Transparenz, wenig Politik und schnellen Entscheidungen.

title: Staff Engineer (AI Native)
description:
Buscamos a pessoa que será referência técnica em engenharia de software AI-native na Bemobi : quem define como os times especificam, delegam a agentes de IA e verificam o que é entregue, sem abrir mão dos fundamentos de arquitetura, qualidade e segurança.
Essa posição responde pelos padrões de desenvolvimento assistido por agentes - specs, contexto, guardrails, verificação e harness compartilhado - e pela confiabilidade do que vai para produção. Atua em desenvolvimento e operação, e mede sucesso por resultado para o negócio e para o usuário, não por volume de código gerado.
#BeABemober 💙🚀

• Especificação e contexto: definir o padrão de specs verificáveis - pré e pós-condições, invariantes, Given/When/Then - e manter o contexto que os agentes usam (, , skills e restrições).

• Decomposição e orquestração: quebrar problemas complexos em unidades que um agente executa e um humano consegue verificar, coordenando vários agentes, worktrees isoladas e passagens de bastão.

• Política de delegação: definir com os times o que se delega à IA (o que é fácil de verificar, de baixo risco ou repetitivo) e o que fica com as pessoas (design, decisões de produto e contexto organizacional).

• Verificação: estabelecer a estratégia de testes, evals, mutation testing e benchmarks, e levar a revisão de código para o foco em intenção e risco, que escala com o volume gerado por agentes.

• Guardrails determinísticos: garantir CI rigoroso, proteção de branch, CODEOWNERS, lotes pequenos e rollback fácil como base de confiança no sistema.

• Segurança desde o início: desenhar agentes com identidade própria, menor privilégio, sandbox e defesa em profundidade, em conjunto com Segurança da Informação.

• Harness como produto: evoluir o setup compartilhado de engenharia - instruções, ferramentas, hooks e skills - incorporando o que se aprende com cada falha.

• Operação e confiabilidade: definir níveis de autonomia dos agentes em produção (L0 a L3), com autorização progressiva, dry-run e mecanismo de parada imediata; tratar cada agente como serviço, com SLOs, observabilidade e plano de contingência.

• IA na operação: aplicar IA onde ela agrega - playbooks, detecção de anomalia, RCA, rascunho de postmortem e handoff de incidente - sem substituir automação clássica que já resolve.

• Formação do time: mentorar ativamente, em especial juniores e plenos, e manter trilhas de fundamentos com prática deliberada sem IA, combatendo a atrofia de habilidades.

• Comunicação com o negócio: traduzir limites, riscos e ganhos da IA para liderança e áreas de negócio, sustentando decisões técnicas com dados.

• Experiência sólida em engenharia de software, com atuação como referência técnica (Staff, Principal ou Tech Lead) em sistemas de produção de alta escala.

• Fundamentos fortes: arquitetura, estruturas de dados, invariantes e fronteiras de segurança - a base para identificar código gerado "quase certo".

• Uso intensivo e comprovado de agentes de IA no dia a dia de desenvolvimento, com domínio de context engineering e spec-driven development.

• Prática em TDD, testes automatizados e evals, e capacidade de desenhar estratégias de verificação para código gerado por IA.

• Vivência com CI/CD, controle de versão, proteção de branch e entrega em lotes pequenos.

• Vivência em operação de sistemas: observabilidade, SLOs, resposta a incidentes e postmortems.

• Segurança aplicada: menor privilégio, isolamento e gestão de identidades e segredos.

• Julgamento e desconfiança calibrada: saber quando parar e conferir, sem rejeitar a IA nem confiar cegamente nela.

• Pensamento sistêmico e de risco, com foco em resultado para o negócio e para o usuário.

• Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas, liderança e negócio, e disposição real para mentorar.

- Experience building a deal desk or deal strategy function from scratch

La production de béton est responsable d'environ 8 % des émissions mondiales de CO2. Ces émissions sont principalement liées à la combustion et à la décarbonatation du calcaire nécessaire à la production du ciment Portland conventionnel.
Les liants à base de magnésie (MgO) sont étudiés comme alternatives potentielles aux ciments conventionnels, avec une empreinte carbone réduite. Le magnésium nécessaire à leur production pourrait être extrait de roches non carbonatées ou de saumures riches en magnésium. Ces ressources constituent des sources alternatives de matières premières et pourraient permettre d'éviter les émissions de CO2 liées à la décarbonatation du calcaire.
Cependant, ces liants alternatifs sont encore en cours de développement et leurs mécanismes d'hydratation, leur composition et leurs propriétés mécaniques doivent être mieux compris. En particulier, la nature et la réactivité de la source de magnésium, ainsi que les conditions de formulation et de préparation, peuvent influencer la microstructure et les performances mécaniques du matériau obtenu.
L'objectif de ce stage est d'étudier différentes sources de magnésium et d'évaluer leur potentiel pour le développement de liants de type MgO-SiO2 présentant de bonnes propriétés mécaniques et un impact environnemental réduit.
Plusieurs formulations de liants seront préparées et étudiées en faisant varier la source de magnésium et différents paramètres de formulation. Les matériaux obtenus seront caractérisés à l'aide de techniques complémentaires afin d'évaluer leur composition chimique, les phases formées lors de l'hydratation, leur microstructure, leur porosité et leurs propriétés mécaniques. title: Instandhaltungmanager ECM 2 (m/w/d)
description:
Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben.

Bei uns sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Züge sicher, zuverlässig und möglichst jederzeit verfügbar sind. Du entwickelst unser Instandhaltungssystem weiter, setzt technische Standards und analysierst Schwachstellen, bevor sie zu größeren Problemen werden. Dabei verbindest du technisches Know-how mit einem hohen Verantwortungsbewusstsein und gestaltest aktiv mit, wie wir unsere Flotte zukünftig instand halten

Über die Rolle

• Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung unseres Betreiber-Instandhaltungsprogramms und stellst sicher, dass Instandhaltungsumfänge, Arbeits- und Prüfanweisungen sowie technische Vorgaben den aktuellen Anforderungen entsprechen (ECM 2)

• Von der technischen Dokumentation bis zur Fahrzeugakte behältst du den Überblick und stellst sicher, dass Fahrzeuggenehmigungen, technische Dossiers und Instandhaltungsnachweise vollständig und nachvollziehbar dokumentiert sind

• Mit Fehler- und Schadensanalysen identifizierst du technische Schwachstellen, bewertest Fahrzeugschäden und leitest nachhaltige Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung von Sicherheit, Zuverlässigkeit und Verfügbarkeit ab

• Bei technischen Änderungen, Abweichungen und dem Ersatz von Komponenten führst du Risikobewertungen nach DIN EN 17023:2018 bzw. DVO (EU) 402/2013 durch, führst das Hazard Log und stellst die Einhaltung sicherheitsrelevanter Anforderungen sicher

• Du gestaltest Themen wie schwere Instandhaltung, Lebenszykluskosten, Obsoleszenz- und Materialmanagement sowie die Auswahl und Auditierung von Werkstätten und Dienstleistern aktiv mit

Über Dich

• Du hast deine technische Ausbildung zum Techniker oder Meister abgeschlossen oder dein Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Fahrzeugtechnik o.ä. erfolgreich abgeschlossen 

• Fundierte Kenntnisse der Eisenbahntechnik sowie Erfahrung mit Instandhaltungsverfahren, sicherheitsrelevanten Systemen und idealerweise ZfP-Methoden zeichnen dich aus

• Mit CSM und Risikobewertungen bist du vertraut und hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit technischen Zulassungs- und Genehmigungsthemen sowie der Zusammenarbeit mit Aufsichtsbehörden

• Dich zeichnet eine analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus und du hast Freude daran, technische Standards und Prozesse eigenständig weiterzuentwickeln

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse (B2) bringst du mit und hast Lust Verantwortung zu übernehmen

• Gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands runden dein Profil ab

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze - auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten

• Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.

• Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.

• Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.

• Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen - für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.

• Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.

• Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
テクニカルアカウントマネージャー (Technical Account Manager)

Asanaのテクニカルアカウントマネジャー（Technical Account Manager: TAM）は、顧客が日々の業務において「明瞭さ（Clarity）」を見出し、Asanaを活用して成果を上げることを支援します。TAMはAsanaのエキスパートであり、顧客の成功に情熱を注ぐ生産性のプロフェッショナルです。顧客からの質問、機能リクエスト、インシデント報告に対応し、中長期的な視点でのAsana活用のためのベストプラクティスを提供します。また、Asana社内では顧客の声を製品開発に反映させるための代弁者となり、製品開発チームと対話します。TAMの成功指標は「顧客の成功」であり、顧客への深い共感（Empathy）を通じてそれを実現します。

AsanaのTAMとして、あなたは大規模かつ複雑な要件を持つエンタープライズ顧客に対し、戦略的な技術アドバイザーとしてサポートを提供します。顧客のステークホルダーと深く連携し、技術的なイネーブルメント（定着化）を推進し、継続的な利用を確実にするとともに、Asanaの機能を顧客の長期的目標に合致させます。この役割は、強力な技術的適性、卓越した顧客への共感力、そして社内外のステークホルダーを巻き込む影響力が求められる、クロスファンクショナルなポジションです。

【勤務地・働き方】

このポジションはAsana Japanの技術本部長にレポートします。

私たちは、居住地に関わらず最適な人材をお迎えしたいと考えています。そのため、ご本人の状況に合わせて以下のいずれかの働き方を用意しています。

•
関東圏にお住まいの方： 東京オフィスを拠点とした、オフィス中心のハイブリッドスケジュール（原則 月・火・木曜出社）となります。

•
関東圏以外にお住まいの方（日本国内）： リモートワークでの勤務が可能です。ただし、チームビルディングや重要会議のため、 月1〜2回程度、東京オフィスへの出社をお願いしています （詳細は面接時にご案内します）。

なお、重要な会議やオンサイト支援など、状況に応じて顧客先への訪問や国内出張が発生する場合があります。

【主な業務内容】

•
顧客への技術的アドバイザリーとベストプラクティスの提供

•
エンタープライズ顧客の導入後における「技術的な成功（Technical Success）」に責任を持ち、Asana活用拡大の主要な技術アドバイザーおよびパートナーとして機能する。

•
Asana API、サードパーティサービスとの連携、認証（SAML/SCIM）、クラウドセキュリティおよび管理者ガバナンスに関するベストプラクティスを、顧客の環境や目標に合わせて設計・提案する。

•
顧客のシステムアーキテクチャ、ビジネス上の優先順位、技術構成に関する深い知識を維持し、ニーズを先読みした提案を行う。

•
顧客の健全性維持とリスク管理

•
顧客との定期的なコミュニケーションや技術レビューを通じて顧客におけるAsana利活用にプロアクティブに関与し、製品価値の定着と継続的な利用を促進する。

•
セールス、カスタマーサクセスマネージャ（CSM）と共同で利用パターンやエンゲージメント傾向からヘルススコアを監視し、リスクの早期発見や、利用拡大・再エンゲージメントの機会を特定する。

•
各種エスカレーション、移行プロジェクト、重大インシデント対応を社内各部門と連携して主導し、予防・早期検知・透明性のあるコミュニケーションを通じてリスクを最小化する。

•
社内連携と製品へのフィードバック

•
社内の技術ナレッジの標準化を推進し、再現性のあるベストプラクティスを策定・共有することで、チーム全体の提案力向上に貢献する。

•
セールス、サポート、プロダクト、エンジニアリングチームと緊密に連携し、統一された顧客体験を提供する。

•
顧客の声を代弁し、実際のユースケースや課題に基づいたフィードバックを行うことで、製品ロードマップへ影響を与える。

【応募資格】

•
経験とドメイン知識

•

description:
Legal Intake Specialist (Remote)
Schedule: Full-Time | Monday - Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST
Apply here:
Position Overview
The Legal Intake Specialist plays a pivotal role as the first step in the healthcare medical records retrieval process. This position ensures that every request is accurate, complete, and optimized for downstream success. The precision and quality of the intake process directly influence the speed and accuracy of medical record retrieval for law firm clients.
Key Responsibilities
1. Provider Research & Identification

• Identify all relevant healthcare providers involved in a clients treatment, beyond the main facility listed by the law firm.

• Research and locate billing providers and related entities using tools such as Chartswap, historical request data, and direct provider outreach.

• Accurately input all identified providers into the admin application.

2. Request Creation & Quality Control

• Review incoming ROIs (Release of Information forms), correcting incomplete or inaccurate submissions (noting that ~90% require adjustments).

• Prepare accurate base forms before generating submission packets.

• Conduct comprehensive quality assurance checks on each ROI packet, verifying inclusion of all required details such as cover letters, affidavits, and other documentation.

3. Request Assignment

• Assign requests to the appropriate records team members based on workload balance and utilization metrics.
4. Handling Special Cases

• Identify and escalate special provider requirements (e.g., unique forms or protocols) to the assigned Client Success Manager (CSM).

• Resolve missing, unclear, or conflicting information by liaising with the law firms case manager.

Requirements

•
Experience: Prior hands-on experience requesting health records from providers on behalf of law firms.

•
Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy; even small mistakes can cause delays of several months.

•
Technical Skills: Proficiency with Adobe Acrobat and other PDF editing/combining tools.

•
Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a proactive problem-solving mindset.

• Build and maintain partner pipeline reports and dashboards for weekly channel reviews

Program operations

title: Wealth Advisor (Boca Raton, FL)
description:
Why Work at Mercer Advisors?

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron’s for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients’ best interests - always.*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent - wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron’s to use the ranking in marketing. The Wealth Path Wealth Advisor works in a client-focused, team-centered environment under the direction of one of the firm’s Managing Directors and Wealth Path leadership to support the team’s region-wide business development and client service efforts. 

Essential Job Functions for the Wealth Advisor will include:

• Functioning as the primary trusted advisor to a book of 150-250 Wealth Path clients

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Senior
description:
A FCamara está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack Senior para atuar em parceria com uma empresa do segmento educacional.
Sobre a Posição
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack com domínio sólido noecossistema .NET e React para atuar na construção e evolução deplataformas escaláveis, distribuídas e nativas em nuvem.
Mais do que dominar a stack tradicional, procuramos umprofissional com mentalidade AI-First : alguém que utilize ferramentas deInteligência Artificial de forma estratégica e contínua para acelerar o ciclode desenvolvimento (SDLC), elevar a qualidade das entregas, automatizar tarefasrepetitivas e focar na resolução de problemas arquiteturais complexos.

Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações web utilizando .NET (C#) no back-end e React no front-end. Projetar e implementar APIs RESTful seguras, performáticas e bem documentadas. Participar da definição da arquitetura de soluções e tomar decisões técnicas com autonomia. Escrever código limpo, testável e seguindo boas práticas (SOLID, Clean Code, design patterns). Realizar code reviews e apoiar tecnicamente pessoas desenvolvedoras mais júniores. Colaborar com times de produto, design e QA em um ambiente ágil. Identificar e resolver gargalos de performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

Responsabilidades

•
Desenvolvimento Backend & APIs: Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços e APIs RESTful/GraphQL de alta performance utilizando .NET (C#) , aplicando princípios de Clean Architecture, SOLID e DDD.

•
Arquitetura Frontend & Microfrontends: Construir interfaces modulares, reativas e escaláveis em React , estruturando e mantendo arquiteturas baseadas em Microfrontends (ex: Webpack Module Federation, Single-SPA) para garantir independência de deploy entre múltiplos times.

•
Desenvolvimento Cloud-Native: Desenvolver e operar soluções orientadas à nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP), utilizando containers (Docker/Kubernetes), arquitetura serverless, mensageria assíncrona e pipelines de CI/CD.

•
Engenharia Aumentada por IA (AI-Driven Development): Utilizar assistentes de IA no fluxo diário para geração de código boilerplate, refatoração assistida, criação automatizada de testes unitários/integração, documentação técnica e revisão de código (Code Review).

•
Qualidade, Segurança e Observabilidade: Garantir a saúde das aplicações em produção por meio de práticas de testes automatizados (TDD/BDD), análise estática de código, monitoramento de performance (APM) e logs distribuídos.

•
Colaboração Técnica: Participar ativamente de discussões de arquitetura, refinamentos técnicos e mentorias, compartilhando boas práticas de desenvolvimento e novos fluxos de produtividade com IA com o restante do time.

Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)

•
Backend: Experiência consolidada com .NET Core / .NET 6, 7 ou 8+ (C#) , Entity Framework Core / Dapper, criação de APIs RESTful e integração com sistemas de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, Azure Service Bus ou AWS SQS/SNS).

•
Frontend: Forte domínio de , TypeScript , gerenciamento de estado complexo (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query) e estilização moderna.

•
Microfrontends: Experiência prática no desenho, implementação e orquestração de Microfrontends , compreendendo estratégias de roteamento distribuído, compartilhamento de dependências, Design Systems e comunicação entre módulos.

•
Cloud & DevOps: Vivência prática no desenvolvimento e deploy de aplicações em provedores de nuvem ( Azure, AWS ou GCP ), uso de Docker, Kubernetes e configuração de esteiras CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps ou GitLab CI).

•
Banco de Dados: Domínio de bancos relacionais (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB).

•
Proficiência em Ferramentas de IA: Experiência comprovada no uso diário de ferramentas de IA aplicadas à engenharia de software (ex: GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT) e técnicas de Prompt Engineering voltadas para geração de código, debugging avançado, migração de código e criação de testes.
